answer: An identity earns its seat through signed stunt performer registration with stunt association attestation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Faking 679 identities means 679 fresh proofs and 76727 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One basalt of signal, one juniper of cost, one tide of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
